'''Darth Vurik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]] order during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[132 ABY]], Vurik was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] by Krayt to [[Mission to Nyriaan|investigate]] rumors of the existence of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'', which dated back to the [[Jedi Civil War]]. After arriving on Nyriaan and locating a Sith settlement, Vurik was attacked by the [[Children of the Tempest|Sith worshipers]] of [[Darth Glovoc]], a Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] who was in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] and encased in an [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]].

During his pursuit of Glovoc's oubliette, Vurik [[Death/Legends|slew]] many of these Sith before eventually being confronted by a group of fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Despite wounding several and slaying one of the Jedi, Vurik retreated from battle to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Nyriaan, [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]]. Failing to apprehend Glovoc's oubliette, Vurik elected to hire [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] down the Jedi on Nyriaan as he continued his search for Glovoc, whose subjects had hidden him in a secret location.

==Biography==
[[File:Nyriaan-goi.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Vurik was dispatched to Nyriaan to search for the ''Dying Sun''.]]
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vurik, a [[Gender/Legends|male]], served the [[One Sith]] order of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="GoI" /> Shortly after Krayt [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and set up [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his own Empire]],<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] discovered rumors that the [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'', a Sith [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that operated during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="GoI" />&mdash;an ancient conflict initiated by the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] Darth [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]<ref name="Inside 88">{{InsiderCite|88|Heritage of the Sith}}</ref>&mdash;had crashed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. In [[132 ABY]], Vurik was dispatched by Krayt to Nyriaan to [[Mission to Nyriaan|investigate]] these rumors, hoping to find [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] such as [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]].<ref name="GoI" />

After Vurik arrived on the planet, he began his investigations and eventually discovered a settlement of the descendants of the Sith survivors of the crash that occurred at the end of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Civil War. Vurik was attacked by these people who called themselves the "[[Children of the Tempest]]"&mdash;beings who were physically and mentally maligned by generations of [[Reproduction/Legends|inbreeding]]&mdash;hoping to defend the [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] of the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Glovoc]], the ''Dying Sun''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and the Sith descendants' [[Deity/Legends|object of worship]]. Vurik [[Death/Legends|slew]] many of the Sith who were attempting to defend Glovoc, who was [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] and held in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] inside the oubliette.<ref name="GoI" />

[[File:DarthGlovoc.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Vurik was determined to apprehend Glovoc and his oubliette.]]
However, Vurik's actions were noticed by [[Nyriaanan|members]] of the local clans, who also were harboring some fugitive Jedi. Vurik was confronted by a group of several of these Jedi; during his confrontation with them, the Sith Lord injured many of the Jedi and killed at least one before he was defeated by them. This caused him to retreat to [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]], Nyriaan's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. During Vurik's battle with the Jedi, the Sith worshipers of Glovoc used the opportunity to move Glovoc's oubliette to a hidden location while Vurik was distracted. After the battle, Vurik was unwilling to report his failure to Darth Krayt. He chose to stay on Nyriaan and attempt to locate Glovoc, hiring [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to find and kill the Jedi who attacked him.<ref name="GoI" />

==Personality and traits==
Darth Vurik was a male Sith Lord who, when confronted by both the Children of the Tempest and the Jedi on Nyriaan, was willing to engage both groups in battle. He was determined to apprehend Glovoc and his oubliette, and, when faced with reporting his failure to Darth Krayt, he chose to instead stay on Nyriaan and continue his search for Glovoc.<ref name="GoI" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Sith Lord in Darth Krayt's One Sith order, Vurik was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. His fighting skills were enough to annihilate many of the members of the Children of the Tempest. His abilities enabled him to wound many of the Jedi who attacked him and kill at least one of them.<ref name="GoI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vurik was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] resource book ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'', in which he functioned as one of the characters who affected the planet Nyriaan's history.<ref name="GoI" />
